jobs.title: AI Video Editor & Creative Content Producer
jobs.description:
**Company:** PurpleBox  
**Location:** Dubai, UAE  
**Job Type:** Part-time

**About the Role**

PurpleBox is looking for a highly creative **AI Video Editor & Content Producer** who understands both traditional video production and the new generation of AI-powered creative tools.

We are **not looking for a basic video editor** who only cuts footage, adds music, captions and transitions.

We want someone who can take an idea or story and turn it into highly engaging, visually impressive social media content by combining:

* Real actors and actresses
* Real footage filmed at our locations
* AI-generated scenes
* AI-generated images and video
* Visual effects
* Creative transitions
* Sound design
* Motion graphics
* Strong storytelling

Our objective is to produce social media advertisements and organic content that make people stop scrolling, watch, engage and remember the PurpleBox brand.

**AI Experience Is Important**

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with **Higgsfield** and/or other leading AI creative platforms.

Experience with tools and models such as the following is highly valued:

* Higgsfield
* Kling
* Veo
* Sora
* Runway
* Midjourney
* Nano Banana / Gemini image tools
* Adobe Firefly
* Other emerging AI image and video generation tools

You should actively follow developments in AI video production and be interested in experimenting with new tools as they become available.

**What You Will Create**

You will work with our marketing team, actors and content creators to produce:

* Instagram Reels
* TikTok-style short-form videos
* Meta advertisements
* YouTube Shorts
* Brand films
* Promotional videos
* Story-driven advertisements
* Cinematic social media content
* Product and service advertisements

The content will primarily promote **PurpleBox Storage and PurpleBox Moving**.

**Your Responsibilities**

You will be responsible for taking content from **concept to final video**.

This includes developing creative concepts and storylines, reviewing scripts, planning shots, editing real footage, creating AI-generated scenes and assets, integrating AI footage naturally with live-action footage, adding motion graphics and visual effects, performing color grading and sound design, and delivering finished content optimized for social media.

You should also be able to look at ordinary footage and think:

**“How can I turn this into something people actually want to watch?”**

We want someone who can transform a simple idea into a story.

For example, instead of producing a standard video showing movers packing boxes, you should be able to build a story around the customer, the problem they are experiencing, the moving process, and the final result—using real footage where appropriate and AI-generated scenes where they improve the story.

**What We’re Looking For**

The successful candidate should have:

* Strong professional video-editing skills
* Excellent understanding of pacing, hooks and short-form storytelling
* Strong experience with Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve or equivalent professional editing software
* Practical experience using AI video and image-generation tools
* Ability to create consistent characters, environments and visual styles using AI
* Understanding of prompting and AI creative workflows
* Strong sense of cinematography, composition, lighting and camera movement
* Ability to integrate AI-generated footage with real footage convincingly
* Strong sound-design and music-selection skills
* Understanding of social media advertising and attention retention
* Ability to work quickly and produce multiple creative variations
* Strong creative judgment and attention to detail

**What We Are NOT Looking For**

We are not looking for someone whose experience is limited to:

* Basic CapCut editing
* Adding subtitles to existing footage
* Using templates
* Simple transitions
* Cutting long videos into short clips
* Completely AI-generated videos with little creative direction

AI should be used as a **creative production tool**, not as a replacement for creativity, storytelling or real production.

**Portfolio Requirement**

**A portfolio is mandatory.**

Please include examples of your best:

* Short-form social media advertisements
* AI-generated video work
* Videos combining AI with real footage
* Cinematic or story-driven content
* Commercial/brand advertisements

Applications without a relevant portfolio may not be considered.

We care more about the **quality of your work, creativity and ability to tell stories** than the number of years you have worked in the industry.

**Application Question**

When applying, please answer:

**Which AI video and image-generation tools do you currently use, and briefly explain how you would combine real actors, real footage and AI-generated scenes to create a 30-second advertisement for a storage or moving company.**

If you are constantly experimenting with new AI creative tools and believe the future of advertising is a combination of **real production + AI + strong storytelling**, we would like to see your work.

Pay: AED30.00 - AED60.00 per hour

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Dubai (Dubai)

jobs.title: Brand Manager | Brand Strategy & Marketing | Catalog
jobs.description:
The Brand Manager for **Art Dei Marmi** will oversee the end-to-end positioning, product catalog development, showroom operational aesthetic, and multi-channel marketing strategies for our luxury natural stone and custom furniture portfolio. This role requires a balance of creative vision, structural luxury product understanding, operational rigor, and strategic leadership to scale the brand across the UAE and regional markets.

**Key Responsibilities1. Brand Strategy & Positioning**

* Own and execute the overall brand vision, narrative, and guidelines across all physical and digital touchpoints.
* Ensure brand consistency, luxury positioning, and messaging integrity across all marketing channels, client communications, and retail environments.
* Monitor market trends, competitor movements, and luxury interior design dynamics in the UAE to identify growth opportunities.

**2. Catalog & Product Line Management**

* Lead the strategy, development, and curation of the Art Dei Marmi product lines, focusing on natural stone (marbles, travertine, natural woods) and high-end bespoke furniture.
* Oversee full catalog management, including product naming, material specifications, technical feasibility parameters, and pricing structures.
* Collaborate closely with production, design teams, and suppliers to launch new collections and streamline product customization protocols.

**3. Showroom Operations & Visual Merchandising**

* Direct visual merchandising and showroom presentation at the Al Quoz flagship location to maintain a premium customer experience.
* Ensure showroom displays effectively showcase marble finishes, natural stone characteristics, craftsmanship, and production quality to prospective clients.
* Train showroom sales and client-facing teams on product knowledge, natural material properties, and brand communication standards.

**4. Marketing & Digital Operations**

* Plan and execute end-to-end integrated marketing campaigns across digital, print, and experiential channels.
* Oversee e-commerce presence, digital catalog displays, and social media content creation to drive brand engagement and showroom footfall.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external partners on performance media buying, asset creation, and promotional activities.

**5. Client Communication & Operational Transparency**

* Establish clear policies regarding custom design fees, technical drafting requirements, and natural stone characteristics to maintain client transparency and protect brand integrity.
* Address escalated client queries or disputes regarding product specifications, material finishes, and delivery timelines in coordination with production and installation teams.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Brand Growth:** Measurable increase in brand awareness, showroom traffic, and digital conversion rates.
* **Catalog Performance:** Successful launching and performance of new product lines and curated marble collections.
* **Operational Efficiency:** Smooth collaboration between design, quotation, production, and marketing workflows.
* **Customer Experience:** High client satisfaction scores and effective communication of product/material guidelines.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* **Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in Brand Management, Marketing, or Product Line Management, ideally within luxury furniture, natural stone, interior design, or high-end architectural products in the UAE market.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Interior Architecture, or a related field.
* **Material & Technical Understanding:** Strong familiarity with natural stone (marble types, travertine), wood finishes, custom furniture production workflows, and technical design drawing requirements.
* **Skills:**
* Exceptional project management and cross-functional leadership abilities.
* Strong aesthetic eye for visual merchandising and luxury product presentation.
* Proficiency with e-commerce platforms (e.g., Shopify), digital marketing channels, and catalog tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (Arabic is a plus).

Pay: AED10,000.00 - AED15,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Head of Brand Partnerships- Middle East & Africa
jobs.description:
Hey there!
  
We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
  
  
Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!  
  
Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission.

**Meet the team**  
We know the impact experiences have on lasting memories. That's why, we help brands connect in a meaningful way with their audience through culturally resonant campaigns.

Operating like a creative agency, our team uses their expertise in entertainment and immersive events to help brands and agencies across the globe **conceptualize, produce, and manage multi-channel campaigns** that give audiences experiences they will remember.

We craft **bespoke strategies** that blend branded content, digital storytelling, ticketed experiences, and premium sponsorships, tailored to each market.

Join us if you're excited to shape global campaigns, craft stories that connect with people everywhere, and bring top brands to life through unforgettable immersive experiences.

**The role**

As our Head of Brand Partnerships for Middle East and Africa based in our Dubai office, you will play a pivotal role in growing Brand Partnerships across the MEA region. Leveraging an established market position, you will build long-term relationships with top brands, media agencies, and strategic partners.  
Reporting to the Global Head of Brand Partnerships, you will collaborate closely with global functions including Media, Strategy, Creative Solutions, Production, Finance, Data & Insights, Legal, Marketing, and Operations to develop and execute scalable brand partnership opportunities. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the company's presence across the Middle East and Africa.

#### **What you'll do**

* Closing high-value sponsorships and media partnerships with leading brands.
* Securing multi-year partnerships for major Originals and premium events.
* Elevating the company's position as the premier experiential-media platform in Iberia.
* Building robust, insight-driven sales strategies and exceeding revenue goals.
* Maintaining a strong pipeline of opportunities that drive year-over-year growth.
* Develop and maintain senior decision-maker relationships across brands, agencies, and sponsorship consultancies.
* Proactively secure and negotiate partnerships leveraging media, experiential, and data capabilities.
* Lead MEA revenue targets, forecasting pipeline health and conversion rates.
* Collaborate internally to create and execute high-impact branded activations, media packages, and content integrations.
* Analyze market trends and audience insights to craft tailored commercial strategies.
* Represent the Middle East and Africa in global strategy alignment, ensuring local insights influence cross-market offerings.
* Lead client meetings, negotiations, and presentations with confidence and strategic insight.
* Mentor and develop a high-performing Brand Partnerships team in the MEA region.
* Track and report on performance metrics, ensuring accountability and continuous optimization.

#### **Who you are**

Experience & Expertise

* 15+ years in partnerships, media sales, sponsorship, or experiential marketing.
* Proven track record of securing scaled partnership deals with top-tier brands and agencies.
* Strong network across Middle East and Africa brand and agency ecosystems.

Skills & Abilities

* Exceptional communication, presentation, and consultative selling skills.
* Experience leading commercial teams in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
* Strong negotiation skills with the ability to structure win-win partnerships.
* Data-driven mindset, comfortable using insights for strategy and storytelling.
* Fluent in English; Arabic a plus but not essential.

#### **Why you'll love it here**

* Attractive compensation package, including stock options to reward your contributions and growth.
* Opportunity to make a real impact in a high-growth global category leader.
* Professional and personal growth from day one with real responsibility.
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.
* Private health insurance with Allianz-Orient: 100% covered by Fever.
* Air ticket: 2100 AED payment for each year of service.
* Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment.

  

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.
